### Century Complete Now Selling New Homes at Hudson Village in Cowpens, South Carolina


October 1, 2026


Single- and two-story floor plans from the mid $200s bring attainable new homes to Spartanburg County


**KEY TAKEAWAYS**


- **Affordable New Homes:** Century Complete is now selling new single-family homes at Hudson Village in Cowpens, South Carolina. Starting from $231,888, the community's new homes put homeownership within reach in Spartanburg County.
- **Five Floor Plans:** New homes at Hudson Village range from 1,155 to 1,965 square feet with 3 to 4 bedrooms.
- **Included Features:** Every home includes quartz countertops, stainless-steel appliances, and 36" Shaker cabinets.
- **Spartanburg Access:** Hudson Village sits minutes from I-85, with Spartanburg 10 to 15 minutes away, plus access to Greenville and Charlotte, N.C.


COWPENS, S.C.


, Oct. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS)—a top national homebuilder, industry leader in online home sales, and featured on America's Most Trustworthy Companies by Newsweek—today announced that its Century Complete brand is now selling new homes at Hudson Village, a single-family home community offering single- and two-story floor plans from the mid $200s. Set in Spartanburg County in South Carolina's Upstate region, Hudson Village is approximately 12 miles from Spartanburg and within reach of Greenville and Charlotte, NC.


**Learn more and explore available homes at**[www.CenturyCommunities.com/HudsonVillageSC](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786747-1&h=3177237947&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2FHudsonVillageSC&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2FHudsonVillageSC) **.**


"With pricing starting from the mid $200s, Hudson Village gives Upstate buyers an attainable path to a brand-new home, in a great location just 10 to 15 minutes from Spartanburg," said Cliff Niederpruem, Regional President. "We encourage buyers to explore our streamlined online homebuying experience to find the floor plan that best fits their needs."


Designed for modern living, homes feature open-concept layouts, quartz countertops, Shaw® flooring, Kohler® fixtures, LG® stainless-steel appliances, 36" Shaker cabinets, an Igloo® smart front door lock, and spacious primary suites with walk-in closets.


**HUDSON VILLAGE | COWPENS, SC**
*Now selling from the mid $200s*


- 138 single-family homesites
- Five floor plans ranging from 1,155 to 1,965 square feet
- 3 to 4 bedrooms, 2 to 2.5 bathrooms, and 1- to 2-car garages
- Quartz countertops, LG® stainless-steel appliances, Kohler® water fixtures, an Igloo® smart front door lock, 36" Shaker cabinets, and more included in every home
- Minutes from I-85 with easy access to Spartanburg, Greenville, and Charlotte, NC


**Community Location:** 5050 Cannons Campground Road
Cowpens, SC 29330
864.335.7596


**VISIT OUR SALES STUDIO**


While our state-of-the-art online homebuying process allows you to buy on your terms—24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year—we also offer in-person assistance from local experts at our Sales Studio.


**Upstate Studio** 1401 Woodruff Road, Suite B
Greenville, SC 29615
864.539.2983


**THE FREEDOM OF ONLINE HOMEBUYING**


Century Complete is proud to feature its industry-first online homebuying experience on all available homes in South Carolina, allowing homebuyers to easily find their best fit and purchase when they're ready—all while continuing to work with their local real estate agent of choice. Homebuyers can further streamline the homebuying process by financing online with Century Complete's affiliate lender, Inspire Home Loans®.


**How it works:**


1. Shop homes at CenturyCommunities.com
2. Click "Buy Now" on any available home
3. Fill out a quick Buy Online form
4. Electronically submit an initial earnest money deposit
5. Electronically sign a purchase contract via DocuSign®


Learn more about the Buy Online experience at[www.CenturyCommunities.com/online-homebuying](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786747-1&h=2500436768&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.centurycommunities.com%2Fonline-homebuying&a=www.CenturyCommunities.com%2Fonline-homebuying) .


**FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS**


**Question:** How much do new homes at Hudson Village cost?
**Answer:** New homes at Hudson Village start from the mid $200s.


**Question:** How many floor plans are available at Hudson Village?
**Answer:** Hudson Village offers five floor plans ranging from 1,155 to 1,965 square feet, with 3 to 4 bedrooms and 1- to 2-car garages.


**Question:** Where is Hudson Village located?
**Answer:** Hudson Village is located in Cowpens, South Carolina, in Spartanburg County, with convenient access to Spartanburg, Greenville and Charlotte, NC.


**Question:** What features are included in Hudson Village homes?
**Answer:** Homes include modern features like quartz countertops, LG® stainless-steel appliances, Kohler® water fixtures, an Igloo® smart front door lock, and 36" Shaker cabinets.


**Question:** Can I really buy a home online?
**Answer:** Yes. Century Complete's industry-first online homebuying lets homebuyers shop available homes and complete a purchase through the Buy Now process, while continuing to work with their local real estate agent of choice.


**About Century Communities** Century Communities, Inc. (NYSE: CCS) is one of the nation's largest homebuilders and a recognized industry leader in online home sales. Newsweek has named the Company one of America's Most Trustworthy Companies for four consecutive years. Through its Century Communities and Century Complete brands, Century's mission is to build attractive, high-quality homes at affordable prices to provide its valued customers with A HOME FOR EVERY DREAM®. Century is engaged in all aspects of homebuilding — including the acquisition, entitlement and development of land, along with the construction, innovative marketing and sale of quality homes designed to appeal to a wide range of homebuyers. The Company operates in 16 states and over 45 markets across the U.S., and also offers mortgage, title, insurance brokerage, and escrow services in select markets through its Inspire Home Loans, Parkway Title, IHL Home Insurance Agency, and IHL Escrow subsidiaries.
